meta.name: Tarantula 1955 colorized (John Agar)
meta.description:
Strange deaths in the Arizona desert intrigue a local doctor (John Agar), who gets help from the new assistant (Mara Corday) to a professor (Leo G. Carroll) experimenting with giving growth hormones to animals to increase the world's food supply.
John Agar as Dr. Matt HastingsMara Corday as Stephanie 'Steve' Clayton
Leo G. Carroll as Prof. Gerald Deemer
Nestor Paiva as Sheriff Jack Andrews

I colorized this using AI software that doesn't always 
get the colors right, but I think it looks fairly natural. Hopefully a 
more professional job will be done someday.
